signal-deep.note: Hover of filled Signal buttons; hard-coded in source, not yet a CSS variable.

display.purpose: Closing statements only: contact band headline and 404 headline.

hero-name.purpose: Name and role in the first viewport; role line in Signal Blue. Smaller than section headlines so the desk owns the stage.

title.purpose: Job roles, skill names, desk panel title, sub-section heads.

lead.purpose: One-sentence muted intro under each section headline.

body.purpose: Descriptions and panel prose, 56 to 60ch max.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, desk labels, metadata lines (600).

shadows.name: panel-drop
shadows.purpose: Desk panel sliding over the 3D scene.

shadows.name: label-lift
shadows.purpose: Floating object labels over wood and screen.

motion.name: label-hover

motion.name: camera-glide

motion.name: object-lift
motion.purpose: Hovered or selected desk object rises slightly.

motion.name: pointer-parallax

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled action in a group: Email me, Read about the project, Back to the front page.
components.html: Email me
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--signal, #2457f5); color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a44d1; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral companion actions: GitHub, LinkedIn, Visit site.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); font: 600 15px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0f1115); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Sticky blurred header: muted section links plus a solid ink Contact button.
components.html: DeskExperienceProjectsContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 10px 16px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground, #f4f5f7) 85%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted, #555b66); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--ink, #0f1115); color: var(--ground, #f4f5f7); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Desk Choice
components.description: The desk's choices as plain pill buttons under the scene, with a plain-language hint; pressed state fills Signal.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); font: 600 14px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-choice-hint { color: var(--muted, #555b66); } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #0f1115); } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--signal, #2457f5); border-color: var(--signal, #2457f5); color: #fff; } .ds-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-choice-hint { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.75); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Desk Label
components.description: Floating pill label anchored to a 3D object; a real button that turns Signal and rises on hover.
components.css: .ds-desk-label { white-space: nowrap; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); font: 600 14px/1.2 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms, color 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-desk-label:hover { background: var(--signal, #2457f5); border-color: var(--signal, #2457f5); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-desk-label:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Desk Panel
components.description: White panel that slides over the right of the scene when an object is chosen; title, ghost back button, plain-language body.
components.html:
Contact

I'm open to student jobs, internships and graduate roles. Email is the fastest way to reach me.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 380px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); } .ds-panel-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 20px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-panel-body p { margin: 0; } .ds-ghost { padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #555b66); font: 600 14px/1 inherit; font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--ground, #f4f5f7); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--signal, #2457f5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Skill Tag
components.description: Small static pill listing the skills a project shows.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-tag { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8dbe0); background: var(--ground, #f4f5f7); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); font: 600 12.5px/1.2 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Marks the current job; Signal Wash with a Signal dot.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--signal-soft, #e5ecff); color: var(--signal, #2457f5); font: 700 12px/1.4 'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--signal, #2457f5); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a quiet studio with one object in it worth looking at: a wooden desk, lit from above, rendered in 3D near the full width of the page. Everything around the desk is cool, pale and flat: a blue-grey ground, white surfaces, hairline rules, near-black ink. The desk carries the warmth (oak grain, a mug, coloured books, a tray of microgreens); the interface around it stays neutral so the scene reads as the subject.

Interaction is "click a labelled thing, get a plain answer". Every object on the desk has a floating pill label that is a real button, and the same choices repeat underneath as ordinary pill buttons. Selecting one glides the camera to the object and slides a white panel in over the right side of the scene. Below the desk the page becomes a conventional, well-ruled document: Experience, Projects, Skills, then a dark contact band.

Density is moderate and type-led. Headings are heavy (800) and tightly tracked; body copy is plain 16px with generous leading. One blue does all the signalling.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutral ground with white surfaces; warmth lives only in the 3D props.
A single signal blue for actions, selection, current state and links.
Schibsted Grotesk at weight 800 with negative tracking for every heading level.
Sections separated by 1px hairline rules, with an ink-coloured rule on the first row of every list.
Pills for choices and tags, 8px corners for actions, 12px for containers, 24px for the stage.
Motion is confined to the desk: camera glide, object lift, panel slide.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: In the interface, Signal Blue is the only chromatic colour. If a UI element is blue, it is clickable, selected, current or focused; nothing decorative is blue.

rules.name: The Props Keep Their Colours Rule
rules.body: The One Signal Rule governs the interface, not the desk. The 3D objects carry their own material colours (oak #b48a62 legs, a yellow #f2b72e and red #e5484d book, green microgreens #4f9d3a / #5cae45, a dark monitor #202227). Do not neutralise props to fit the UI palette; do not lift prop colours into the UI.

rules.name: The Weight Not Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Schibsted Grotesk's 800 against 400/600; never introduce a second display face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All labels, buttons, headings and nav are sentence case at normal tracking. The system has no uppercase or letter-spaced small text.

rules.name: The Only Over The Scene Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist only on elements that hover over the 3D canvas. Anything in the document flow is flat, separated by tone and hairlines.

dos: Do route every action, selection, current state and focus through Signal Blue, and nothing else.
Do keep every heading in Schibsted Grotesk 800 with negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.04em by size).
Do separate in-flow content with 1px Hairline rules and tonal bands; start ruled lists with an Ink rule.
Do give every 3D object a visible text label that is a real button, and offer the same choices as plain pill buttons outside the canvas.
Do keep the desk panel's content plain-language and readable without the scene; on phones, render it below the stage.
Do honour reduced motion: the camera cuts, parallax stops, transitions collapse to 1ms.
Do define both light and dark values for every new colour variable.
donts: Don't add shadows to anything in the document flow; shadows are for elements floating over the scene.
Don't add a second accent hue to the interface; prop colours stay on the desk.
Don't use uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't require 3D controls (orbit, drag, zoom) to reach any content; navigation is click-a-label only.
Don't introduce motion outside the desk; the rest of the page does not animate on its own.
Don't hard-code colours that the variables already cover; Deep Signal, the contact-band link blues and the copy button's hover ink should resolve through tokens.
